mapper.select: SELECT d.dept_name AS deptName, COUNT(e.id) AS personCount FROM sys_dept d LEFT JOIN emp_employee e ON d.id = e.dept_id AND e.status != 3 GROUP BY d.id, d.dept_name ORDER BY personCount DESC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') AS reportMonth, IFNULL(SUM(total_amount), 0) AS totalAmount FROM expense_report WHERE status != 'REJECTED' AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL ${months} MONTH) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY reportMonth ASC

SELECT e.name, d.dept_name AS deptName, COUNT(r.id) AS reportCount, IFNULL(SUM(r.total_amount), 0) AS totalAmount FROM expense_report r LEFT JOIN emp_employee e ON r.emp_id = e.id LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON e.dept_id = d.id WHERE r.create_time >= CONCAT(#{year}, '-', LPAD(#{month}, 2, '0'), '-01 00:00:00') AND r.create_time < DATE_ADD(CONCAT(#{year}, '-', LPAD(#{month}, 2, '0'), '-01'), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) GROUP BY r.emp_id, e.name, d.dept_name ORDER BY totalAmount DESC LIMIT 5
